title: Checking the News
text:
Anna reads a news story on her phone. The story says a famous singer is sick. Anna feels worried and wants to share it with her friends.

But Anna's brother reads the story again. He sees that the website is new and that the writer has no name. He tells Anna that the story is probably fake.

questions.text: What does the story on Anna's phone say?
What does Anna's brother notice about the website?
options: It is new and the writer has no name

questions.text: What can you infer about Anna's brother?
options: He is careful and checks information

questions.text: What can you infer about Anna at the beginning of the story?
options: She trusts the story too quickly
She does not use social media
She wants to delete her phone

vocabulary.definition: feeling afraid or unhappy about something
to send a story or post to other people
a place on the internet with pages of information

paragraph_translations: Anna telefonunda bir haber okur. Haberde ünlü bir şarkıcının hasta olduğu yazıyor. Anna endişelenir ve bunu arkadaşlarıyla paylaşmak ister.
Ama Anna'nın ağabeyi haberi tekrar okur. Web sitesinin yeni olduğunu ve yazarın adının yazılmadığını görür. Ona göre haber muhtemelen sahtedir.
